title: Agricultural device, has switch device including sensor for detecting raised position or lowered position of distributor, so as to determine distance of distributor to soil surface, where sensor is formed as non-contact probe
abstract: The device has a distributor with a frame and a reservoir arranged at a lifting device of an agricultural tractor. A drive motor is provided for driving a seed dosing device (7), where a switch device is provided for automatic switching on and off of the drive motor. The switch device includes a sensor (8) for detecting a raised position or a lowered position of the distributor, so as to determine a distance (A) of the distributor to a soil surface (9), where the sensor is formed as an ultrasound based non-contact probe.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): It switches seed dosing on and off, but may only provide basic automation
Second Reviewer: Initially labeled with "?". I decided to label it as 1 (belongs to PA). The device has sensing (distance to soil) as well as reacting capabilities.

title: On-site verification system for agricultural product
abstract: The invention discloses a field authentication system for farm products, and belongs to the field of agriculture science and technology. The system comprises an authentication database and a mobile authentication terminal which is in data connection with the authentication database. Various information required by the authentication of the farm products is stored in the authentication database; the data connection comprises local data connection and wired or wireless remote data connection; the mobile authentication terminal comprises a data acquisition module, a data storage module and a data processing module; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring authentication data; the data storage module is used for storing the authentication data; the data processing module is used for comparing the authentication data with declaration information in the authentication database; and the data acquisition module can comprise a GPS positioning sub-module so as to realize the GPS positioning of authentication places. The system of the invention can provide reference values of production plates and surrounding ecological environment thereof, thereby avoiding severe error of acquired information. In addition, the system has better application prospect.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): verifies agricultural products rather than managing crops or field operations.

title: Weight distribution controlled by sectioned product container of agricultural application implements
abstract: A self-propelled agricultural product application implement such as high clearance sprayer and/or spreader is provided that includes a product container that is sectioned. Emptying of the container sections is controlled to approximate a target front-to-back weight distribution of the implement for a substantially long period of time during a product application session. An outlet system having multiple variable outlet arrangements is arranged between the product container and an application arrangement such as a spray boom or a rotary broadcaster. The variable outlet arrangements are configured to allow the container sections to sequentially empty to maintain ballast provided by the store product at relatively later portions of the implement for a relatively longer period of time during the product application session.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): Technique to balance machine’s weight rather than adjusting treatment to field conditions.

title: Improvements in or relating to pasture management
abstract: A plant matter sensor (100), the sensor (100) comprising a pair of parallel spaced apart sensor arms (2) and a control console (3), a first of said arms (2) having a plurality of emitter means (6) spaced along its length, each emitter means (6) configured and arranged to, in use, emit a signal substantially perpendicularly to the said arm to be received by a corresponding receiver means (7) on the second arm (8), the console (3) containing control means to, in use, control the rate, strength and regularity of the signal emitted by each of the said emitter means (6), collection means to, in use, collect data from each receiver means (7) as to the existence or absence of receipt of a signal, processor means to process data received from the control means and the collection means and determine the height of any plant matter traversed by the plant matter sensor (100) and predetermined intervals, and storage means to store the plant matter height data generated by the processor means for subsequent download or analysis.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): Regards pasture, not cultivation

title: Method and system for plant protection spraying operation based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention provides a method and system for a plant protection spraying operation based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing surveying and mapping data for a plant protection area based on an airborne agricultural information monitoring platform; calculating a plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle operation route trajectory in the plant protection area based on the obtained remote sensing surveying and mapping data; and controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a spraying operation device to complete the plant protection task according to the designed plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle operation route trajectory based on a backstepping trajectory tracking controller. The obtained agricultural geographic information serves as the basis of the subsequent spraying route trajectory design, the route trajectory of surrounded spraying is designed, and the spraying route of the plant protection spraying operation is designed according to the topographical relation of the plant topographic order.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses remote sensing to plan and control drone spraying.

title: Data acquisition module for an agricultural machine and related systems and assemblies
abstract: In one aspect, a system for acquiring data associated with an agricultural field. The system includes an agricultural machine and a data acquisition (DAQ) module supported relative to the agricultural machine. The DAQ module includes a module housing and one or more sensing devices housed within the module housing. The one or more sensing device are configured to generate data associated with a condition of a field as the agricultural machine travels across the field. In addition, the system includes an air circulation system provided in operative association with the DAQ module that is configured to direct an airflow into an interior of the module housing for circulation therein.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): collects field-condition data through sensors on an agricultural machine.

title: Agricultural machinery automatic navigation control method based on double-antenna GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) and preview tracking model
abstract: The present invention discloses an agricultural machinery automatic navigation control method based on a double-antenna GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) and a preview tracking model. According to the method, a clock-shared integrated dual-antenna GNSS receiver supporting multi-satellite system carrier phase difference technique is used for performing positioning and attitude measurement of agricultural machinery; and a piecewise adaptive foresight distance related to speed is adopted as a parameter in a preview tracking model, so that path tracking control can be performed on the agricultural machinery. A positioning board card supporting the multi-satellite system carrier phase difference technique can effectively increase the number of satellites participating in positioning calculation and improve the precision and stability of navigation and positioning; navigation satellite system-based inertial navigation attitude measurement can improve the accuracy and real-time performance of the attitude measurement of the agricultural machinery; the design and simulation of driving behaviors of a user by the preview tracking model algorithm have predictability, and therefore, a path tracking control effect is good, the quickness and stability of the launch of the agricultural machinery and the adaptability of the agricultural machinery to compacted field road conditions can be improved; and the foresight distance is related to speed, and therefore, the control accuracy and stability of an agricultural machinery automatic navigation system in relatively high-speed operation can be improved.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses GNSS to guide agricultural machinery automatically.

title: WEEDING UNIT AND METHOD FOR TREATING AN AGRICULTURAL FIELD
abstract: A weeding unit (4a, 4b) for treating an agricultural field (9) includes a carrier (10), at least one working lever (15a, 15b) moveably connected with the carrier (10), at least one actuator (11, 12) for moving the at least one working lever (15a, 15b) and a control unit (14). The control unit (14) is configured to distinguish crop (7) from weed (8) and to control the at least one actuator (11, 12) for treating the weed (8). The at least one working lever (15a, 15b) includes a weeding knife (18, 27) and at least one harrowing tine (26, 35). The agricultural field (9) may be treated according to a method.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): distinguishes weeds from crops and treats weeds selectively.

title: Cultivated land change detection method and device
abstract: The invention provides a cultivated land change detection method and device, and relates to the technical field of cultivated land detection, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining sample remote sensing image data which comprises cultivated land remote sensing image data of the same region at different times; preprocessing the sample remote sensing image data to obtain target remote sensing image data; an initial cultivated land change detection model is constructed, the initial cultivated land change detection model is trained by using the target remote sensing image data, a target cultivated land change detection model is obtained, and the initial cultivated land change detection model is a model constructed by combining a multi-layer segmentation fusion convolutional network constructed based on a U-net model with a residual network and an attention mechanism; after the to-be-detected remote sensing image data is obtained, the to-be-detected remote sensing image data is input into the target cultivated land change detection model, the cultivated land change result image is obtained, and the technical problem that existing cultivated land change detection is poor in detection precision and speed is solved.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): detects changes in cultivated land, but its use for crop management is unclear.
Second Reviewer: Should probably also be labeled with (1). refer to https://www.mdpi.com/2072-4292/17/5/787 Seems to be helping one aspect of precision agriculture (use for crop management does not need to be specified imo). For further affirmation, one could refer to the definition for PA that is given by the International Society of Precision Agriculture

title: System and method for generating origin place packing label of agricultural products
abstract: The invention discloses a system and a method for generating an origin place packing label of agricultural products, relating to the technical field of origin place labels of the agricultural products. The system comprises a terminal and a server side. The terminal comprises a core processing module, an RFID (Radio Frequency Identification Device) circuit, a GPS (Global Position System) module, aGPRS (General Packet Radio Service) module and the server side, wherein the core processing module is used for sending RFID card information as well as the longitude and latitude information of the place of the terminal to the server side, coding and encrypting the RFID card information, the longitude and latitude information of the place of the terminal, and the information of the agricultural products so as to generate a two-dimensional bar code, and encrypting the two-dimensional bar code to generate an origin anti-fake label of the agricultural products; the RFID circuit is used for identifying the RFID card information and sending the RFID card information to the core processing module; the GPS module is used for positioning the place of the terminal and sending the place informationto the core processing module; the GPRS module is used for realizing the communication of the core processing module with the server side; and the server side is used for receiving and verifying the RFID card information and the longitude and latitude information of the place of the terminal which are sent from the core processing module. The controllability, the anti-fake property and the safetyof the system and the method are higher.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): certifies product origin rather than supporting crop management.

title: AGRICULTURAL LAND LOT DATA PRODUCTION SYSTEM
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image processing system allowing reduction of a burden on a user and allowing production of data on a land lot of agricultural land or the like, based on an observed image obtained by photographing a ground surface from a high altitude.

SOLUTION: The agricultural land lot data production system includes: a lot extraction means extracting a lot becoming a candidate of the agricultural land from the observed image obtained by photographing the ground surface from a high-altitude flight body such as a satellite or an airplane; and a lot classification means classifying use of the agricultural land candidate lot. The lot classification means includes: a noise decision means calculating a noise amount of each area of the agricultural land candidate lot; a vegetation decision means calculating a vegetation index of each area of the agricultural land candidate lot; and a shape decision means calculating a shape of each area of the agricultural land candidate lot.

COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT
Reasoning (First Reviewer): maps agricultural plots, but its use for field management is unclear.
Second Reviewer: Seems to just be about selection (of good candidate lots) - perhaps pre-PA?

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle for agricultural pesticide spread
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for agricultural pesticide spread. The unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a vehicle body and a control table. Propeller blades are in movable connection with the center of the top of the vehicle body; a stirring tank is in fixed connection with the left side at the bottom of an inner cavity of the vehicle body; a motor is in fixed connection with the top of the stirring tank; and an output shaft of the motor penetrates through the stirring tank, extends into the inner cavity of the stirring tank and is in fixed connection with a rotating rod. Through the arrangement of the motor, the rotating rod, stirring blades, a water inlet pipe, a water pump, a water outlet pipe, a water spray tank and a nozzle, effect of pesticide spread to crops is achieved; through the arrangement of a water level sensor, a first single chip computer, a first wireless transceiver, a control keyboard, a displayer, a second wireless transceiver, an alert, a storage device and a second single chip computer, effect of remote control is achieved, and therefore effect of time-saving and labor saving during pesticide spread is achieved, difficulty in agriculture work is reduced and efficiency of agriculture work is improved.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): Controls pesticeds spraying but idk if in a "precision" manner
Second Reviewer: Probably falls in PA, but I do agree that there may not be enough qualifiers here for PA (so labeled as 0). To me, it's about the fact that the device itself doesn't seem to be smart enough to do it's own bidding.. (no automatic spreading or detection)

title: Pesticide tank locking device for plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to a pesticide tank locking device for the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a frame, hooks, locking clamps, a bottom plate and locking devices, the hooksare evenly installed at the upper end of the frame, the bottom plate is installed at the lower end of the frame, the locking devices are installed at the lower end of the bottom plate, and the lockingclamps are evenly arranged at the upper end of the bottom plate in the circumferential direction of the bottom plate. The problems can be solved that when an existing pesticide tank is placed into the locking frame, a gap exists between the pesticide tank and the locking frame since the sizes of the existing pesticide tanks are different and the size of the pesticide tank is not matched with thatof the locking frame; when the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle carries out spraying operation, the pesticide tank shakes due to the gap, so the working stability of the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle is reduced; and the existing locking frame and the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle are generally connected through bolts, so the locking frame needs to be integrally detached when the pesticide tank is replaced, and the detaching time is long.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): secures a drone’s pesticide tank, without a precision farming function.

title: Crop leaf insect pest detection method and system
abstract: The invention relates to a crop leaf insect pest detection method and a crop leaf insect pest detection system. The method comprises obtaining an insect pest image of a crop leaf, and performing gray processing on the insect pest image to obtain an insect pest gray image; extracting an insect pest edge contour line of the insect pest gray image through adoption of an edge detection technology, wherein the insect pest edge contour line is a boundary between an insect pest region and a background; filling the insect pest region within the insect pest edge contour line by utilizing a seed point filling method so that a pixel value of the insect pest region is equal to a pixel value of the insect pest edge contour line and a binary image is obtained; and determining the area of the insect pest region in the binary image, and determining a number of insect pests of the crop leaf according to the area of the insect pest region. The insect pest detection method automatically, accurately and rapidly determines the number of crop insect pest tetranychid mites on the leaf, and provides a modern auxiliary method and a modern auxiliary tool for crop protection and research. The method and the system have an important significance in insect pest forecasting and prediction.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): analyses leaf images to detect and count crop pests.

title: AUTONOMOUS DRIVING METHOD, WORK VEHICLE, AND AUTONOMOUS DRIVING SYSTEM
abstract: To provide an autonomous driving method, a work vehicle, and an autonomous driving system with which it is possible to suppress autonomous travel not intended by an operator.SOLUTION: A combine 1 is a work vehicle that autonomously travels on the basis of a preset travel route, and is provided with; an autonomous travel enable switch 34 that is an autonomous travel enable operation member for enabling autonomous travel; and a control device 50 that functions as an autonomous travel control part 62 for controlling autonomous travel on the basis of the travel route. The autonomous travel control part 62 executes autonomous travel on the basis of the travel route while the autonomous travel enable switch 34 is being operated (pressed).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
Reasoning (First Reviewer): controls the safe activation of autonomous driving in a combine harvester.

title: AGRICULTURAL WORK SYSTEM AND METHOD OF OPERATING AN AGRICULTURAL WORK SYSTEM
abstract: An agricultural work system and a method for operating an agricultural work system is disclosed. The agricultural work system comprises an agricultural production machine having two axles, a power lifter, and a driver assistance system, and an attachment connected to the agricultural production machine using the power lifter. The driver assistance system optimizes operation of the agricultural production machine by determining an axle load on at least one of the axles. Further, actual data records coupled in time to the execution of an agricultural work process are cyclically determined by the driver assistance system to automatically adjust the power lifter. In particular, an axle load ratio currently at the axles is determined as an actual data record and, using at least one additional actual data record to be determined, the driver assistance system automatically generates instructions to actuate the power lifter while simultaneously accounting for mutually influencing optimization target variables.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): adjusts the tractor’s axle load, but its link to precision field operations needs checking.
Second Reviewer: Has some driver assistance based on data collection. It also makes automatic decisions. The only thing that bothers me is that there is no mention of the benefit. The only vague mention is "optimizes the operation of the agricultural production machine". However, I still think that it probably is PA. Apparently soil compaction can cause adverse effects and this should counter that

title: WORK MACHINE
abstract: The present invention can generate an appropriate travel route in accordance with work. A work machine (1) comprises: a vehicle body (2); a first work device (60A) that performs first work; a travel device (4); a first work acquisition unit (57e) that acquires first information regarding the first work device (60A); a second work acquisition unit (57f) that acquires section information regarding a second work device (60B) for performing second work, which is work preceding the first work; a route acquisition unit (57g) that acquires a second route (L2), which is a path of the second work; and a route generation unit (57d) that generates a first route (L1), which is a path of the first work and includes a plurality of first sections (La1). The route acquisition unit (57g) acquires a plurality of second sections (La2) as the second route (L2). The route generation unit (57d) generates the plurality of first sections (La1) by shifting the plurality of second sections (La2) in a direction perpendicular to the plurality of second sections (La2), on the basis of the first information acquired by the first work acquisition unit (57e) and the second information acquired by the second work acquisition unit (57f).
Reasoning (First Reviewer): plans work routes, but the abstract does not clearly identify an agricultural application.
Second Reviewer: I agree with your analysis

title: Automatic citrus picking method and device based on mechanical arm
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic citrus picking method and device based on a mechanical arm. The method comprises the following steps: determining a target region range according to information of a current position, searching a citrus variety corresponding to the target region range and a mature citrus color value interval corresponding to the citrus variety, intercepting a citrus image from an initial image, carrying out a color detection to obtain a current citrus color value, judging whether a target citrus corresponding to the citrus image is a mature citrus or not according to the current citrus color value and the mature citrus color value interval, when the target citrus is a mature citrus, determining a target branch corresponding to the target citrus according to the initial image and determining a cutting position, controlling a first mechanical arm to move a picking basket to an area below the citrus and a second mechanical arm to move a cutting device to the cutting position, and cutting target branches by controlling the cutting device to enable the target citrus falls into the picking basket to reach an effect of intelligently picking the citrus. A problem of waste caused by mistaken picking is avoided.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): identifies ripe citrus fruit and controls robotic picking selectively.

title: Automatic citrus reticulata blanco disease and insect pest recognition device based on convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention relates to an automatic citrus reticulata blanco disease and insect pest recognition device based on a convolutional neural network; the device comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and a collector arranged at the bottom side of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the top side of the unmanned aerial vehicle is fixedly connected with a gas guide mechanism, and the gas guide mechanism comprises a gas collection pipe and a gas guide pipe; one end of the gas collection pipe is located on a wind direction line of a rotor wing of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the other end of the gas collection pipe is connected with one end of the gas guide pipe, and the other end of the gas guide pipe is located on the peripheral side of the collector; through the arrangement of the gas collection pipe, wind power generated by the rotor wings of the unmanned aerial vehicle is led to the gas guide pipe through the gas collection pipe, and the gas guide pipe guides the wind power to the peripheral side of the collector, so that dust brought by the rotor wings of the unmanned aerial vehicle is not easy to attach to the collector when the unmanned aerial vehicle collects information; and the accuracy of the convolutional neural algorithm of the collector is influenced.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): supports image collection for detecting diseases and pests in citrus crops.

title: METHOD FOR AUTOMATIC PEST CONTROL AND APPARATUS FOR EXECUTING THE METHOD
abstract: Disclosed are an automatic pest control method to increase pest control efficiency and an apparatus for executing the same. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the automatic pest control method is executed in a computing device including one or more processors and one or more programs executed by the one or more processors. The automatic pest control method comprises the following steps: receiving an operation signal from a controller according to a user's operation and moving according to the operation signal; measuring location information when receiving the control signal from the controller while moving according to the operation signal; extracting a point corresponding to the measured location information from stored cadastral information; calculating a pest control area including the point from the cadastral information; generating pest control path information on the basis of the pest control area; and performing pest control on the control area while moving according to the control path information.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): plans pest-control routes using location data, but the crop-production context is unclear.
Second Reviewer: Pest control falls within the farming practice (one of the pillars of PA) of protection (there are 4 possible options and protection is one of them) and the system is clearly precision based. I'd go with 1

title: WORKING VEHICLE
abstract: To provide a working vehicle in which automatic steering is stopped in conjunction with the stoppage of work.SOLUTION: A working vehicle traveling while repeatedly switching between manual steering and automatic steering, comprises: a traveling device 11 being steerable; a working device for performing work; a steering operation tool 42 for the manual steering; a steering control unit 30 capable of executing the automatic steering for making a machine body automatically travel in accordance with a traveling standard by controlling the traveling device 11; and a detecting unit 21 for detecting the stoppage of the work. When the stoppage of the work is detected by the detecting unit 21 during the execution of the automatic steering, the steering control unit 30 terminates the automatic steering.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3
Reasoning (First Reviewer): controls automatic steering, but an agricultural application is not clearly stated.
Second Reviewer: Most likely PA, but it's not possible to discern with just this abstract. Stoppage of work most likely refers to some agricultural work.

title: WORK AREA SETUP SYSTEM, WORK AREA SETUP METHOD AND WORK AREA SETUP PROGRAM
abstract: To provide a work area setup system for setting up a work area in which contact of a work vehicle with an obstruction can be avoided, work area setup method and work area setup program.SOLUTION: A position acquisition section acquires position information of a work vehicle. A travel track generation section generates a travel track R1 of the work vehicle based on the position information acquired by the position acquisition section. An interpolation point generation section generates, as selection object points, first interpolation points P1, P2, P3 and P4, the intersections of extensions of two adjacent straight lines connecting the travel track R1 generated by the travel track generation section, and second interpolation points P1a, P1b, P2b, P2c, P3c, P3d, P4a and P4d within an area from the travel track R1 to the first interpolation point. A work area generation section generates a work area of the work vehicle based on the selection object points to be selected by a user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6
Reasoning (First Reviewer): defines safe work areas for vehicles, but the crop-production context is unclear.
Second Reviewer: Same as above.

title: Portable apparatus for detecting early crop diseases based on spatial frequency domain imaging and detection method using same
abstract: A container (2, Fig. 2), for enclosing a plant, has a telescopic section (4, Fig. 2) and opening/closing apparatus (5, Fig. 2) at its base. In SFDI apparatus 3, within the container, light from source(s) 301 passes through collimating lens(es) 302 to digital micromirror apparatus (312, Fig. 5) which structures the light. The light is then reflected through achromatic lens 305 towards reflector 309, which directs it downwards through linear polariser 306 in the base of the housing 317 into the container. Light reflected/scattered by a plant in the container passes upwards through linear polariser (307, Fig. 4) in the base of the housing and into camera 308. In the opening/closing apparatus, a framework of members (501, Fig. 9) radiates from elastic middle section (502, Fig. 9). Opening/closing members (502, Fig. 9) attached to the ends of the middle section move within an outer circumferential guide rail. Light-shielding cloth (504, Fig. 9) connected to the middle section has an opening at the opening/closing members.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): It uses plant imaging to detect crop diseases at an early stage.

title: DRONE SYSTEM, DRONE SYSTEM CONTROL METHOD, AND OPERATION DETERMINATION DEVICE
abstract: [Problem] To enable many drones to operate for a long period and carry out tasks efficiently even when there is a variation from the work plan. [Solution] A drone system 500 in which a plurality of drones 100a, 100b that execute a task in a work area are connected to an operation determination device 40 that acquires the positions and statuses of the plurality of drones and determines the operations of the plurality of drones, wherein the plurality of drones comprise a first drone 100a performing a first task and a second drone 100b performing a second task, and the operation determination device is equipped with a task completion detection unit 42 that detects when the first drone has completed the first task, and a reassignment unit 44 that, on the basis of the detection by the task completion detection unit, determines at least a portion of the second task to be the next task for the first drone.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): coordinates drone tasks, but no agricultural task is specified.
Second Reviewer: Agree with you!

title: Modeling trends in crop yields
abstract: A method and system for modeling trends in crop yields is provided. In an embodiment, the method comprises receiving, over a computer network, electronic digital data comprising yield data representing crop yields harvested from a plurality of agricultural fields and at a plurality of time points; in response to receiving input specifying a request to generate one or more particular yield data: determining one or more factors that impact yields of crops that were harvested from the plurality of agricultural fields; decomposing the yield data into decomposed yield data that identifies one or more data dependencies according to the one or more factors; generating, based on the decomposed yield data, the one or more particular yield data; generating forecasted yield data or reconstructing the yield data by incorporating the one or more particular yield data into the yield data.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): analyses crop yield data across fields and time to produce yield forecasts.

title: System and method for processing images of agricultural fields for remote phenotype measurement
abstract: A method for processing images of an agricultural field is disclosed that enables accurate phenotype measurements for crops planted in each research plot of the agricultural field. The method comprises receiving a plurality of input images of the agricultural field, calculating and refining object space coordinates for matched key points in the input images and an object space camera pose for each input image, calculating and refining object space center points for the research plots based on a user-defined plot layout, and generating output images of individual research plots that are centered, cropped, orthorectified, and oriented in alignment with planted rows of crops. Based on the output images, accurate phenotype measurements for crops planted in each research plot can be determined. The method advantageously minimizes row-offset errors, variations in canopy cover and color between images, geometric and radiometric distortion, and computational memory requirements, while facilitating parallelized image processing and analysis.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): processes field images to measure crop characteristics in individual research plots.

title: Dynamic spray buffer calculation
abstract: In one embodiment, a method that comprises retrieving by a processing unit an application plan from memory, the application plan comprising coordinates for a buffer area associated with dispensing a product onto a field; receiving information from a weather station, the information corresponding to substantially current climatic conditions detected by the weather station in the field; responsive to receiving the information from the weather station, adjusting the application plan; and causing an agricultural machine to operate according to the adjusted application plan.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): adjusts agricultural application plans using field weather data and buffer zones.

title: Agricultural producing area soil monitoring point arrangement method based on step-by-step grid refinement
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural producing area soil monitoring point arrangement method based on step-by-step grid refinement. The method comprises the steps of collecting the administrative map and land use map of a target area; distributing initial grids, looking for and refining monitoring points, arranging the monitoring points one by one till a monitored target agricultural producing area is covered by the monitoring points according to the land use type and a step-by-step refined grid, and forming an agricultural producing area soil preset monitoring point distribution diagram. According to the method, basic maps or drawings and the GIS space analysis technique are fully utilized, blindness during agricultural producing area soil monitoring point arrangement and sampling is reduced, accuracy, representativeness and scientificity of agricultural producing area soil monitoring point arrangement are improved, and operation and implementation are made easy for basic sampling personnel.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): plans agricultural soil sampling, but its use for managing crops is unclear.

title: A remote sensing image cyclic classification method based on training sample automatic optimization
abstract: The invention relates to a cyclic classification method based on training sample automatic optimization. According to the method, the training samples used for next classification are continuously adjusted and optimized by fully utilizing the precision information provided by the previous classification result, and then the remote sensing images are automatically classified again by adopting the optimized classification training samples; In this way, a cyclic classification process is formed, and classification is stopped until the classification precision of the two times tends to be stable.The method has the advantages that training samples are automatically optimized, the same training samples are utilized to the maximum extent, and compared with the same classification algorithm, themethod is high in precision and applicability. Through verification, the method is suitable for most supervised classification methods in remote sensing classification application; Particularly, whena training sample contains a lot of noises, the training sample needs to be automatically optimized to improve the classification precision. In practical application, the method is mainly applied to remote sensing classification involving a large range of land coverage/utilization or themes (e.g., crops).
Reasoning (First Reviewer): improves general land-cover classification; its role in crop management needs checking.
Second Reviewer: I'd give it a warm but not hot (1). There is no mention of agricultural terms until the very end; however, I think that them mentioning "crops" should be enough for a (1). Improved classification could make it easier for farmers to distinguish areas with a lot of weeds/pests from other areas.

title: sistema e processo de monitoramento de peso em esteiras de transporte de produtos com taliscas
abstract: SISTEMA E PROCESSO DE MONITORAMENTO DE PESO EM ESTEIRAS DE TRANSPORTE DE PRODUTOS COM TALISCAS'. A presente invenção refere-se a um monitor de Produtividade de canade-açúcar, para elaboração de mapas de produtividade, requisito básico para a implementação da agricultura de precisão (AP), que permite a aplicação de um sistema de gerenciamento de produção eficiente. O sistema proposto não depende de sensores de pressão hidráulica que além de caros são mais complicados de serem instalados. A determinação do peso dos rebolos de cana-de-açúcar é obtida por medidas diretas e não por medidas indiretas. Sensores de inclinação do elevador garantem a correção destes valores para qualquer tipo de terreno que a colhedora estiver trabalhando. O programa computacional dedicado desenvolvido para gerenciar as informações obtidas das células de carga e dos sensores instalados na colhedora permite a obtenção da quantidade de cana-de-açúcar sendo colhida e de mapas de produtividade se um equipamento de GPS estiver acoplado a colhedora. O sistema de controle eletrónico recebe o sinal já tratado do sensor de peso, da velocidade da esteira transportadora, do sensor de velocidade de deslocamento da colhedora e do sensor instalado no sistema de corte de base. Essas informações juntamente com as coordenadas obtidas por um GPS instalado na colhedora, permitem a elaboração de um mapa digital que representa a superfície de produção da área colhida.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): measures harvested sugarcane weight and combines it with GPS data to create yield maps.

title: AUTONOMOUS AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTION MACHINE
abstract: An assistance system based on electronic data exchange for enabling an autonomous vehicle to act as an autonomous agricultural production machine and an autonomous agricultural production machine is disclosed. The assistance system is configured to plan the deployment of at least one autonomous vehicle, to transmit the information required for the deployment to the autonomous vehicle, to at least partially control the autonomous vehicle during working mode and to monitor the working mode of the autonomous vehicle.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): It plans, controls and monitors autonomous agricultural operations.

title: GPS-based agricultural intelligent platform
abstract: The invention discloses a GPS-based agricultural intelligent platform which comprises an FRID label, an FRID reader-writer, a data acquisition module, a GPS positioning module, a climate collection module, a data analysis module and an information pushing module, wherein the FRID label is used for labelling the production places and sale prices of the crops; the FRID reader-writer is used for reading the FRID label information; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring data and transmitting the acquired data to a central server group; the GPS positioning module is used for marking the longitude and latitude information; the central server group is used for saving the received data into a database and the database saves the agricultural yields of each place of the country over the years and the market average price of the crops of the year; the climate collection module is used for collecting the weather information; the data analysis module is used for taking the data, outputting the yields and price curve charts of the crops according to the data, predicting the yields and prices of the crops of the year according to the yields and the price curve chart and drawing the planting map of the year; the information pushing module is used for pushing the yields, the price curve charts predicted by the data analysis module and the planting map to a client. The GPS-based agricultural intelligent platform has the advantage that the food waste is avoided.
Second Reviewer: May fall more in the bucket of digital agriculture.

title: Intelligent and automatic agricultural data collection system based on big data
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent and automatic agricultural data collection system based on big data. The agricultural data collection system comprises a data collection center, a data processing center, a data storage center, a data display center and a suggestion reminding unit; an output end of the data collection center is electrically connected with an input end of the data processing center; the output end of the data processing center is electrically connected with the input ends of the data storage center, the data display center and the suggestion reminding module; the system disclosed by the invention is scientific and reasonable, safe and convenient to use; the influence on crops growth period by different environment data can be computed by collecting different data in the environment, and the growth period of the crops under the current environment elements can be accurately calculated, the farmer does not need to survey the mature condition of the crops by going tothe field; the optimal appropriate harvesting time can be selected through the weather change at the harvesting time point, and the influence on the crops yield by the man-made fault can be effectively avoided.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses environmental data to estimate crop maturity and recommend harvesting time.

title: Dynamic area thresholding for automatic crop health change detection and alerting system
abstract: A method and system for crop health change monitoring is provided. The method includes acquiring a companion image of a crop growing within a field at a first point in time, acquiring a master image of the crop growing within the field at a second point in time, and computing, using a processor, vegetation indices using the master image and the companion image for subsequently determining regions of change within the master image. An alert condition is determined if change within one or more of the regions of change is sufficient to meet defined criteria. If a minimum field area threshold is met, a modulation coefficient is applied to the defined criteria that determines the alert condition. The coefficient reduces area-based thresholds used in health detection in a manner proportional to the size of the agricultural field of interest.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): compares crop images over time to detect local health changes and send alerts.

title: Automatic control micro-irrigation device
abstract: The invention provides an automatic control micro-irrigation device comprising an information collection unit and an irrigation unit. The information collection unit comprises a GPRS wireless collector. The irrigation unit comprises a water pump, a water spray pipe, a humidity sensor and a control valve, wherein the control valve is electrically connected to the water pump, and the humidity sensor is in sensing connection with the GPRS wireless collector. Thus, the automatic control micro-irrigation device integrates the functions of collection, wireless data transmission and remote control, achieves automation of internal water source irrigation of greenhouses, saves water sources, guarantees appropriate irrigation of soil, and achieves high efficiency agriculture and precision agriculture.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): combines moisture sensing and automatic control for greenhouse irrigation.

title: Efficient spraying device based on unmanned aerial vehicle technology and operation method
abstract: The invention relates to an efficient spraying device based on an unmanned aerial vehicle technology and an operation method. The efficient spraying device comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and spraying assemblies carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle. A medicine box is arranged at the top of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the plurality of spraying assemblies are arranged at the top of the medicine box and distributed at intervals. Each spraying assembly comprises a fixed part, a movable part and a spray head, wherein the fixed part is fixedly installed at the top of the medicine box, the top of the fixed part is connected with the movable part in a matched manner, the movable part can rotate, the end of the movable part is connected with an air bag in a matched manner, and the position, located at the inner side of the air bag, of the end of the movable part is connected with the spray head in a matched manner; and a plurality of air holes are formed at the edge of each air bagin the circumferential direction at intervals, and the air holes spray air to form an air curtain.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): improves drone spraying hardware, but "precision" crop treatment is not clearly described.
Second Reviewer: I agree with your analysis.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR SUPPORTING FERTILIZER DECISIONS
abstract: Systems and methods for supporting fertilizer decisions are provided. The systems and methods may be configured to receive data relating to the application of a liquid fertilizer to a field having a number of rows. The data may include at least one fertilizer characteristic and yield data relating to each row of the number of rows. The systems and methods may be configured to receive a request from a user to analyze the data. The systems and methods may be configured to compare the at least one fertilizer characteristic and the yield data for each row of the number of rows. The systems and methods may be configured to communicate the results of the comparison to the user.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): compares fertilizer application and yield data by row to support fertilizer decisions.

title: Agricultural plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle capable of spraying in large area
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle capable of spraying in a large area. The agricultural plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a rack and four supporting legs arranged on the rack, the bottom of the rack is fixedly connected with a liquid storage barrel, a mounting shaft is rotatably mounted in the liquid storage barrel, the outer wall of the mounting shaft is connected with a stirring mechanism used for mixing pesticide liquid. One end of the mounting shaft extends to the outer wall of the liquid storage barrel and is fixedly provided with a driving paddle, the end, close to the driving paddle, of the liquid storage barrel is provided with a driving mechanism enabling the mounting shaft to rotate, and the other end of the mounting shaft extends to the outer wall of the liquid storage barrel and is fixedly provided with a second circular plate. Through the ingenious design of the structure, self-adaptive adjustment between the flight speed and the spraying amount of the unmanned aerial vehicle is achieved, so that the problem of uneven regional spraying is avoided, meanwhile, the unmanned aerial vehicle can adapt to different spraying environments conveniently, and the energy utilization rate is improved.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): adjusts spraying amounts to flight speed to avoid uneven application.

title: METHOD OF ORGANIC FERTILISER APPLICATION
abstract: FIELD: agriculture. ^ SUBSTANCE: method involving identification of field areas, determination of the humus content in soil and differentiated amounts of organic fertilisers based on the average fertiliser amount for the whole field using remote sensing. During remote sensing interpretation of spectrozonal satellite images is performed to determine soil properties, and a colour bleed scale of the humus content in soil is prepared using the dendrographic analysis. ^ EFFECT: method allows to accelerate process of humus determination using soil contours and to differentiate organic fertiliser amounts for application. ^ 3 dwg
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses satellite images and soil properties to vary fertilizer amounts across field areas.

title: AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS PROCESSING CENTER ADAPTIVE ANALYSIS SYSTEM AND PROCESSING METHOD THEREOF
abstract: An agricultural products processing center (APC) adaptive analysis processing system includes SaaS input/output system configured to implement agricultural product decision-making ERP system adapted to an APC by using an application program interface provided by SaaS platform, request analysis from PaaS analysis system, receive an analysis result, and output the analysis result to be visualized to only an APC which has requested the analysis, the PaaS analysis system configured to adaptively analyze demand and supply prediction and a demand and supply trend of agricultural products by using an analysis performing module in response to input data and the analysis request received from the ERP system, based on APC information and APC algorithms received from an IaaS storage system and transmit an analysis result to the SaaS input/output system, and the IaaS storage system configured to transmit the APC information and the APC algorithms to the PaaS analysis system.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): predicts product supply and demand for processing centres rather than managing crops.

title: Operating agricultural machines involves acquiring field processing/machine operating data with on-board computer, automatically transmitting to central server for local operator access
abstract: The method involves acquiring field processing data and/or machine (1) operating data with an on-board computer (4) and automatically transmitting the acquired data to a central server (8) by data telecommunications and storing the data in a central database (9). The data or data derivatives can be transmitted to a local workstation (10) of a machine operator and/or can be called up from the server. AN Independent claim is also included for the following: an arrangement for operating agricultural machines.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): collects and shares field-operation and machine data for agricultural management.

title: System and Method for Providing Crop Information using Drone Image
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for providing harvest information using drone images and a method therefor. To this end, the present invention relates to a harvest information providing system, comprising: a network driver which stores pre-processed information including captured drone images, electronic maps of agricultural lands, and field measurement data; and a web server which generates various pieces of harvest information using collected preprocessing information and visually provides the generated various pieces of harvest information. The web server includes: an image matching unit which receives drone images and electronic maps of agricultural lands and matches the drone images on the electronic maps of agricultural lands; a thematic map generation unit which generates a thematic map regarding various pieces of harvest information using at least one among the transmitted drone images, electronic maps of agricultural lands, and field measurement data; and an image provision unit which visually provides the drone images or the generated thematic map on the UI by agricultural land lot number or boundary unit. As a result, various entities such as local governments, farmers, and consulting organizations capture drone images and provide the captured drone images to a network driver, and the thematic map generation unit of the web server provides thematic maps on various pieces of harvest information using the drone images and field measurement data.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): combines drone images and field measurements to create crop and harvest maps.

title: Farmland irrigation probability index calculation method based on crop moisture indication line
abstract: The invention discloses a farmland irrigation probability index calculation method based on a crop moisture indication line, and the method comprises the steps: firstly determining the geospatial reference and temporal-spatial resolution of regional irrigation monitoring, collecting and preprocessing a multi-source data set, and generating a raster data set which has the same geospatial reference and temporal-spatial resolution and has aligned pixels; then calculating a crop water deficit index and a crop water stress index of the farmland area pixels, and constructing a crop water dispersion point diagram taking the deficit index as a horizontal coordinate and the stress index as a vertical coordinate; extracting an upper boundary point and a lower boundary point of the crop water dispersion point diagram, and respectively carrying out straight line fitting to form an upper crop water indication line and a lower crop water indication line; and finally, establishing a farmland irrigation probability index model according to the upper and lower indication lines, and calculating a regional farmland irrigation probability distribution diagram. The crop water deficit degree can be accurately, simply and conveniently expressed, and the physical significance and the indicating significance of the farmland irrigation probability index are improved.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): maps crop water stress and deficit to support irrigation monitoring.

title: Method and apparatus for optimization of the working parameters of an agricultural working machine
abstract: Optimization program map is assigned to each operating parameter in a memory unit. The optimization program map is sub-divided into sub-program maps. Optimization is transmitted to the sub-program maps of individual agricultural working machines (1). An independent claim is also included for a device for optimizing operating parameters of agricultural working machine.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): optimizes agricultural machine settings, but the abstract gives too little detail about how.
Second Reviewer: Agreed

title: WORK VEHICLE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a work vehicle avoiding a situation of fertilizer shortage in seedling planting fertilizing travel and stabilizing growth of a crop as well as capable of replenishing the fertilizer with good efficiency.SOLUTION: A work vehicle includes: a fertilizer scattering a fertilizer; a GPS (1p) detecting a travel position; and a terminal (R) with map function. The fertilizer includes: a fertilizer residual amount sensor (8s). The terminal (R) has control calculating an expected residual amount expected for field travel in a reciprocation stroke following a current position in a field by the map function from a fertilizing travel distance by the GPS and progress information of a fertilizer residual amount, and issuing warning when the expected residual amount is 0 or less. Thereby, an operator can recognize fertilizer shortage beforehand and work efficiency is ensured by coping with the fertilizer shortage beforehand.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
Reasoning (First Reviewer): combines GPS and fertilizer-level data to predict shortages during field operations.

title: SOIL MEASURING DEVICE
abstract: To provide a soil measuring device capable of avoiding interference with measurement due to foreign objects such as straw.SOLUTION: A soil measuring device 1 provided on moving means moving across a farm land and measuring soil components with moving of the moving means, comprises a soil excavation part 2 for excavating soil 8, a soil sensor part 4 connected to a rear part of the soil excavation part 2, connected to the moving means via a mechanism mounting part 3, and measuring the soil components, and a cover 5 for covering from the soil sensor part 4 to the mechanism mounting part 3. The cover 5 includes a first inclination part 5a disposed at the soil excavation part side, and a second inclination part 5b connected to the first inclination part 5a and disposed at the mechanism mounting part side, where an angle θ1 formed between the first inclination part 5a and the second inclination part 5b is an obtuse angle. In a front view shape of the soil measuring device 1 viewed from the moving direction of the moving means, the cover 5 has an asymmetrical shape in which the central axis B of the cover 5 is inclined from the central axis A of the soil sensor 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
Reasoning (First Reviewer): supports soil sensing while a machine moves across farmland.

title: PRECISION FARMING SYSTEM WITH SUSTAINABILITY MEASURE
abstract: A method of selecting a treatment recommendation to improve sustainable farming of a field includes obtaining soil from the field and measuring biologic content in the soil. The biologic content is used to determine an ability of the soil to sequester a greenhouse gas and the ability of the soil to sequester the greenhouse gas is used to select a treatment recommendation to increase the ability of the soil to sequester the greenhouse gas.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses measured soil biology to recommend field treatments.

title: POSITIONING DEVICE, WORK VEHICLE, POSITIONING METHOD, AND POSITIONING PROGRAM
abstract: To provide a positioning device, a work vehicle, a positioning method, and a positioning program with which, when determining the position of a moving object on the basis of correction information that corresponds to a specific base station, it is possible to prevent the base station from being switched over.SOLUTION: A first positioning processing unit 151 executes stand-alone positioning for calculating the position of a work vehicle 10 on the basis of satellite signals received from satellites. A transmission processing unit 152 transmits stand-alone positioning information to a base station server 20 that selects one base station. An acquisition processing unit 153 acquires correction information that corresponds to the one base station from the base station server 20. A second positioning processing unit 154 executes RTK positioning for calculating the current position of the work vehicle 10 on the basis of the correction information. When RTK positioning of the work vehicle 10 based on first correction information that corresponds to a first base station becomes possible, the transmission processing unit 152 transmits the stand-alone positioning information immediately before RTK positioning becomes possible to the base station server 20.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
Reasoning (First Reviewer): looked at description

title: VERTICAL GARDEN FOR PLANT CULTIVATION WITH SELF-WATERING SYSTEM DROP BY DROP
abstract: Vertikalni vrt za uzgoj bilja sa samozalijevanjem kap po kap, sastavljen od standardnih četvrtastih, plastičnih, spremnika (1, 2, 3 … n) u koje je ulivena voda (4), nasuta zemlja (9) i posađeno bilje (10), naznačen time, da se spremnici (1, 2, 3 … n) međusobno rotiraju za 90?, učvrste na sva četiri ugla; spremnici (1) i (2) malim vijcima (11´), a spremnici (2) i (3… n) malim čavlićima (12´) za sredine gornjih stranica donjeg spremnika, tako da čine kompaktnu statičku cjelinu. Patent sadrži još 3 patentna zahtjeva.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): Not in english + the title describes a self-watering vertical garden without sensing or adaptive irrigation control.

title: AGRICULTURAL VEHICLE STEERING APPARATUS
abstract: The present invention relates to a steering apparatus for an agricultural robot-type vehicle and, more specifically, to a steering apparatus for an agricultural robot-type vehicle, which is capable of safely performing a steering function even on a non-packaging road. The steering apparatus is applied to an agricultural unmanned transfer vehicle, and comprises: a wheel support unit which is coupled to each inner side of a wheel and has a wheel rotary shaft on the upper side; a base unit which has both sides combined with the wheel rotary shaft; a rotary guide unit which is arranged on the upper side of the base unit and has a center penetrating and coupled to the wheel rotary shaft through; a wheel link unit which is arranged on the upper side of the rotary guide unit and has one end coupled to the wheel rotary shaft; a motor unit which is arranged on the lower side of the base unit; a gear unit which is arranged on the upper side of the motor unit and is arranged on the lower side of the base unit; a steering rotary shaft which is connected to the gear unit and is extended toward the upper side by penetrating the central part of the base unit; a steering link unit which is arranged on the upper side of the base unit and has one end coupled to the steering rotary shaft; and a steering connection unit which has one end coupled to the wheel link unit and the other end coupled to the steering link unit to be rotated.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): describes steering hardware for an agricultural robot, but not sure about its precision farming role.
Second Reviewer: Agreed

title: REAL TIME LABEKING METHOD AND SYSTEM USING SELF LEARNING OF AGRICULTURAL IMAGE BASED ON DEEP LEARNING
abstract: The present invention relates to a method and system for agricultural image self-learning labeling using deep learning. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the agricultural image self-learning labeling system using deep learning comprises: an object detection unit which learns an image of a crop in real time using a deep learning model, and detects an object corresponding to the crop in the image using the learned data and labels the same with a bounding box; a phenotype processing unit which predicts a polygon shape from the bounding box of the image using a deep learning model and generates phenotype analysis data calculating a phenotype of the crop; and a self-learning unit which detects the object and links the bounding box with the phenotype analysis data, and classifies the same as data to be used for learning, and trains the deep learning model using the data to be used for learning.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses deep learning to detect crops and measure their characteristics from images.

title: Agricultural harvester biomass estimating system
abstract: A biomass estimating system for an agricultural harvester includes a sensor arrangement disposed to sense standing crop adjacent to the agricultural harvester and disposed to sense a portion of ground adjacent to the agricultural harvester that has been previously harvested. An ECU receives signals indicating the standing crop and signals indicating the portion of the ground and calculates an estimated biomass of the standing crop based at least upon the signals indicating the standing crop and the signals indicating the portion of ground.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses sensors on a harvester to estimate standing crop biomass.

title: System and Method for Activity Validation
abstract: A system for animal population activity verification may include a user device configured to receive one or more chore completion inputs, a barn node configured to identify an interaction between the barn node and the user device, and a barn hub communicatively coupled to the barn node. In embodiments, the barn hub is configured to: identify a spatial relationship between the barn hub and the user device; receive identified interaction data; and receive the one or more chore completion inputs. In embodiments, the system further includes a server configured to: receive the one or more chore completion inputs, the identified interaction data, and identified spatial relationship data; store a transaction log in memory; and identify one or more incomplete chores of the list of chores based on at least one of the one or more chore completion inputs, the identified interaction data, and the identified spatial relationship data.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): about animals

title: Reforestation equipment using aviation equipment
abstract: The apparatus consists of an unmanned drone aircraft and a cartridge capsule (3) for storing plant material. The capsule cartridge (3) consists of a cartridge body (1) with a removable attached top cover (2), a hollow block central portion (11), a rounded front portion (12) and a wedge-shaped rear portion (13) with rounded walls. In the central part (11) there is a perforated base (7) with openings for receiving vertical tubes (6) for receiving capsules (3) with plant material and a substrate for plant material nutrition. Each of these tubes (6) has solenoids (61) housed in the clamps (62) forming the retention mechanism of the housed capsules (3). In the rounded portion (12) of the cartridge body (1), which simultaneously forms the aerodynamic front cover of the device, there is a cartridge control plate (5) with a control unit including control software and other electrical and electronic components of the device for discharging the capsules (3) from the cartridge. To the upper side of the container body (1), which has at least three threaded inserts (8), is attached by screws and these threaded inserts (8) the upper container cover (2) copying the overall shape of the container body (1) itself. An assembly of individual compression springs (21) is attached to the underside of the cartridge by a number and location corresponding to the number and location of the tubes (6) for receiving the capsules (3) located in the holes in the perforated base (7).
Reasoning (First Reviewer): about reforestation

title: Path following in vehicle formations
abstract: A method of maintaining vehicle formation includes receiving a desired along path distance; receiving a plurality of waypoints corresponding to a plurality of positions along a path of the lead vehicle; determining a dynamic path for the follower vehicle by spline fitting the plurality of positions of the plurality of waypoints; determining a commanded curvature of the follower vehicle based on a curvature of the dynamic path at a current position of the follower vehicle; determining a current along path distance between the lead vehicle and the follower vehicle; determining an along path error; determining a next speed of the follower vehicle based on the along path error and the respective waypoint speed of the respective waypoint that is adjacent to a current position of the follower vehicle; and outputting the commanded curvature and the next speed to a control system of the follower vehicle.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): controls vehicles following each other, but an agricultural application is not specified.

title: Multifunctional pesticide spraying unmanned aerial vehicle equipment
abstract: The invention discloses multifunctional pesticide spraying unmanned aerial vehicle equipment. The equipment comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a box body, a balance mechanism and a pesticide spraying mechanism; and the box body is installed below the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the balance mechanism is installed in the box body, the balance mechanism comprises a balance plate, a fixing rod is rotationally connected to the interior of the balance plate, and one end of the fixing rod is rotationally connected to the interior of the box body. when the unmanned aerial vehicle body shakes at the same time due to external shaking, the situation that the medicament in the medicament storage box shakes is reduced and the stability of the box body is kept by using the balance mechanism, so that the balance effect of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is improved, the safety of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is ensured, and the situation that the unmanned aerial vehicle body crashes is avoided; and the pesticide spraying mechanism is installed on the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that remote intelligent pesticide spraying is achieved, the labor cost is reduced, and the pesticide spraying efficiency is improved.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): stabilizes a drone’s pesticide tank without describing targeted or adaptive spraying.

title: Agriculture and forestry operation task generation method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to an agriculture and forestry operation task generation method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a terrain simulation model, wherein the terrain simulation model comprises spatial geometric information of a target scene, agriculture and forestry digital asset information and first equipment related information ofan agriculture and forestry robot, acquiring a cruise scanning result acquired when the unmanned aerial vehicle cruises the target scene, and updating agriculture and forestry digital asset information in the terrain simulation model according to the cruise scanning result, determining a target agriculture and forestry asset to be subjected to plant protection according to the updated agricultureand forestry digital asset information, simulating an agriculture and forestry operation path in the terrain simulation model according to the target position information of the target agriculture and forestry assets, enabling the agriculture and forestry operation path to pass through each target agriculture and forestry asset, and generating an agriculture and forestry operation task accordingto the agriculture and forestry operation path, and sending the agriculture and forestry operation task to the agriculture and forestry robot to enable the agriculture and forestry robot to execute the agriculture and forestry operation task according to the agriculture and forestry operation path. The method can improve the agriculture and forestry operation efficiency.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses drone scans to identify plants needing protection and plan robotic treatment routes.

title: FOREST RESTORATION METHOD
abstract: FIELD: forestry.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to forestry during artificial forest restoration and promotion of natural reforestation, in particular, to methods ensuring restoration of forest on areas hard to recover or inaccessible for ground-based means of mechanization and human. When implementing method of forest restoration, including groups of area preparation operations, preparation of forest reproductive material, seeding of seeds or planting of seedlings on area, additionally includes group of operations of monitoring. Alternative rapid analysis and encapsulation operations carried out in field conditions using mobile equipment are additionally introduced into a group of operations for preparing forest reproductive material. In the group of operations of seeds sowing or planting of seedlings on the area the additional operation of spot sowing of seeds or planting of seedlings from air is carried out, which is carried out using unmanned aerial vehicles of helicopter, aircraft or hybrid types, equipped with taking into account their take-off mass navigation equipment based on closely-integrated inertial-satellite system, equipment for simultaneous storage of sown seeds or planted seedlings, control of specified seeding rate of seeds or planting seedlings by quantitative or mass basis and accurate seeding or planting of seedlings depending on specified scheme of location of forest crops and speed of unmanned aerial vehicle, energy accumulating equipment.EFFECT: advantages of the proposed method of forest recovery on hard-to-recover areas are the acceleration of the reforestation process and the higher environmental safety by reducing the number of operations which disturb the forest ecosystem, use of environmentally safe energy sources in technical means of monitoring, preparation of reproductive material, sowing or planting, reduction of costs for performance of energy-intensive operations of area preparation, transportation of reproductive material to the place of preliminary preparation and back.1 cl, 1 dwg
Reasoning (First Reviewer): concerns forest restoration

title: SMART ORCHARD HARVESTING CART WITH ANALYTICS
abstract: An orchard harvesting cart with a receptacle, a position determining system, a load sensor, and at least one camera. As a plurality of harvested fruit items are collected and placed within a receptacle of the harvesting cart, image data from at least one camera is processed to evaluate at least one characteristic of the fruit items within the field of view of the camera including, for example, determining whether a harvested fruit item was ready for harvesting. The orchard harvesting cart also includes a position determining system and a load cell allowing the cart to monitor and detect when new fruit items are added to the receptacle and to correlate information determined by image analysis with geospatial locations in the orchard.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): combines fruit images, weight and location data to monitor orchard harvesting.

title: Variable pesticide application control method and device based on image recognition
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a variable pesticide application control method and device based on image recognition. The method comprises the steps: adopting a laser radar to obtain a depthimage of an operation area; determining a crop leaf surface contour image according to the depth image; and determining leaf surface parameters according to the leaf surface contour image, and determining a pesticide application amount according to the leaf surface parameters, wherein the leaf surface parameters comprise the ratio of the gap area to the leaf surface area. According to the method,real-time identification and detection of the canopy region of the mixed crop can be realized, and target variable pesticide application is carried out according to the canopy leaf surface coverage degree of the detection result, so that the pesticide application accuracy can be improved.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): adjusts pesticide amounts according to crop canopy measurements.

title: Crop canopy in-situ growth phenotype monitoring device and three-dimensional reconstruction method
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a crop canopy in-situ growth phenotype monitoring device and a three-dimensional reconstruction method. Through a data acquisition and collection module arranged on a canopy top, an image acquisition module arranged in a canopy, and a fisheye lens arranged on a canopy bottom, the morphological structure data of the top, the interior and the bottom of the canopy of the crop to be detected can be obtained, and the height and the angle of the image obtaining module in the canopy can be adjusted, so that the morphological structure data in the canopy are richer, and finally, the growth monitoring of the canopy of the crop to be monitored is more accurate and overall, and the universality is very good. The canopy growth monitoring device is used for obtaining the morphological structure data of the top, the interior and the bottom of the canopy, the morphological structure data are used for phenotypic analysis and three-dimensional reconstruction after certain pretreatment, the workload is small, the efficiency is high, and the obtained three-dimensional reconstruction model is high in precision.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses images and 3D reconstruction to monitor crop canopy growth.

title: Forest pest control technology based on multi-rotor UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle) for spraying pesticides
abstract: The invention discloses a forest pest control technology based on a multi-rotor UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle) for spraying pesticides. By aiming at a traditional method adopting manual on-site field pesticide frequently for planting and pest control of forest, although the accuracy is higher, many troubles and shortcomings exist in actual operation and engineering surveying, and therefore, firstly, a range of a forest pest infected area to be subjected to pesticide spraying should be known; then route planning is performed in the range of the forest area to be subjected to pesticide spraying by ground station software, and meanwhile, pesticide liquid is added to a spraying system device; and besides, various parameters of the UAV are calibrated, the UAV is ready to take off, the UAV spraysthe pesticide to the forest along the route, and finally, efficient and fast pesticide spraying is carried out in the overall forest range.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): targets forest pests rather than agricultural crop production.

title: Automatic agricultural product pesticide spraying device based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic agricultural product pesticide spraying device based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The device comprises an input unit for enabling a user to input agricultural product related information, a generating unit for automatically generating this pesticide spraying information on the basis of the input agricultural product related information, a blending unit for automatically blending pesticide to be sprayed on the basis of the generated pesticide spraying information, a delivery unit for delivering the blended pesticide to be sprayed to the unmanned aerial vehicle, and a control unit for controlling flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle and spraying of pesticide on the basis of the generated pesticide spraying information. The technical problem that the efficiency is low and the effect is power during existing pesticide spraying are solved, and the device has the technical effects of being reasonable in design, high in spraying efficiency and good in spraying effect.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): adjusts pesticide preparation and drone spraying using crop-related information.

title: Regional crop yield estimation method based on set assimilation strategy
