abstract: The invention discloses a regional crop yield estimation method based on a set assimilation strategy. The method comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing LAI data of a prediction year Y and previous M years in a research region; for the (Y-1) th year, carrying out difference assimilation to obtain a plurality of grid scale simulation yields, a plurality of corresponding groups of correlation coefficients r and a root-mean-square error rmse; calculating a fitting index F according to r and rmse, and obtaining a plurality of fitting indexes in total; selecting a maximum fitting index as an optimal result, and recording a corresponding assimilation weight as an optimal assimilation weight Hop _ y-1 of the (y-1) th year; s3, repeating the steps S2 to S5 for y-2, y-3-y-M years to obtainoptimal assimilation weights Hop _ y-2, Hop _ y-3-Hop _ y-M of each corresponding year, and calculating the optimal assimilation weights Hop _ y-3,-Hop _ y-M of each corresponding year; and expandingan assimilation weight value interval Hlow-Hup, and then performing simulation yield estimation on the prediction year Y by utilizing the assimilation weight value interval Hlow-Hup.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): combines remote sensing and crop modelling to estimate yields across an area.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle system which comprises an STM core control unit, a lithium battery unit, a power management unit, a GPS and sensor unit and a four-rotor flight power unit, and the lithium battery unit, the power management unit, the GPS and sensor unit and the four-rotor flight power unit are all connected with the STM core control unit. Compared with the prior art, according to the data analysis of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the system can more scientifically and accurately know the planting and growth conditions of the plants in the land parcels, so that farmers can scientifically manage the land parcels, apply fertilizer according to the land parcels and plants, and exert the maximum optimization of cultivation.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses drone data to monitor crop growth and support field-specific fertilization.

title: Dynamic remote-sensing forage and livestock monitoring and grazing early-warning method
abstract: The invention provides a dynamic remote-sensing forage and livestock monitoring and grazing early-warning method, and belongs to the fields of dynamic remote sensing meadow monitoring and grazing early warning. The method comprises that nutrition indexes including biomass, crude protein, neutral washing fibers, acidic washing fibers and stock-carrying capacity reflecting the nutrition value of meadows are calculated by means of multi-source remote-sensing sequential images; and the livestock grazing route, nutrition demand and stock-carrying capacity are calculated via a livestock grazing system and nutrition supplementary feed, the meadow nutrition supply and livestock nutrition demand are analyzed, the herbage nutrition change process of a rotation grazing district is monitored quantitatively, the dynamic nutrition balance is analyzed, and early warning is implemented. The method is suitable for high-score remote-sensing vegetation index data. Indexes of different links of remote-sensing dynamic meadow nutrition monitoring are researched quantitatively, so that forage and livestock nutrition balance and grazing monitoring early warning can be researched qualitatively, it is ensured that the meadow nutrition change and dynamic forage and livestock nutrition balance of a divided pasture can be reflected in higher precision, and more accurate information is provided for a nutrition balancing decision.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): about livestock

title: sistema de pulverização agrícola com drones
abstract: sistema de pulverização agricola com drones a presente patente de invenção refere-se a sistema de pulverização agrícola com drones (1) ,o qual será destinado à pulverização de defensivos na agricultura de forma a obter a máxima largura de faixa de aplicação deste defensivo, sendo formado por drones (2 ) que suspenderão por sobre toda a cultura a ser pulverizada ,as mangueiras flexíveis de defensivo ( 3 ) juntamente com a fiação elétrica e de controle (5 ) e os bicos pulverizadores (4) os quais estarão conectados à maquina pulverizadora ( 6 ) sendo que depois de executar a tarefa de pulverizar os drones ( 2) farão a aterrisagem sobre os tripés dos drones (7 ) para não danificar os bicos pulverizadores (4).
Reasoning (First Reviewer): increases spraying width using drones, without describing targeted or adaptive application.

title: Vehicle-mounted fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle sending and recycling integrated platform and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle sending and recycling integrated platform and a control method thereof. A vehicle-mounted platform and a sending and recycling integrated carriage are adopted. The sending and recycling integrated carriage comprises a carriage shell, a top cover plate, an unmanned aerial vehicle storage box, an X-direction sliding rail, aY-direction sliding rail, a Z-direction sliding rail, an X-direction motor, a Y-direction motor, a Z-direction motor, a double-axis rotating mechanism, a clamping jaw mounting plate, a mechanical clamping jaw, a distance sensor, a target pose capturing unit and a computer. The increasing variety of unmanned aerial vehicles can be recycled, and undercarriages of original unmanned aerial vehicles only need to be simply changed, so that the platform adapts to the vehicles. Compared with other recycling modes, the platform nearly does not damage to the unmanned aerial vehicles, the recycling andsending speed is high, and the full-automatic unmanned aerial vehicle sending and recycling capacity is achieved; and besides, the deployment is fast, and the platform can be applied to the fields such as earthquake relief work, anti-terrorist and anti-explosion, agricultural operations and geological exploration and is wide in application prospect.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): launches and retrieves drones; agriculture is only one possible application.

title: Agricultural plantation intelligence management system
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural plantation intelligence management system and relates to the electronic information technology field. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and a fixing terminal. The unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a control module, a shooting module and a data storage module. The fixing terminal comprises a data processing module, a data receiving module and an instruction emission module. When the unmanned aerial vehicle is operated, the shooting module and the control module send collected data to the data storage module, and then send the data to the data receiving module of the fixing terminal through a data emission module. After the data processing module analyzes the data, the fixing terminal sends an instruction of spraying a control signal to an instruction receiving module through the instruction emission module and the instruction receiving module transmits the instruction of spraying the control signal to a spraying device. The unmanned aerial vehicle is used to spray pesticides and nutrient solutions. Through measuring a wind direction and other indexes, positioning is accurate. An agricultural plantation environment and the like can be monitored and an application prospect is wide.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): analyses plantation data to control pesticide and nutrient spraying

title: Positioning method
abstract: The invention relates to a positioning method, and the method comprises the steps: prestoring a coconut tree distribution map of a coconut forest, wherein the coconut tree distribution map provides the segmentation information of all coconut trees, and the segmentation information of the coconut trees comprises the coordinate information of the coconut trees and the 'Picked' marks of coconut trees; receiving the positioning data transmitted by a navigation satellite, so as to determine the current navigation position of a system; receiving the preset coconut tree distribution map and the current navigation position, determining a coconut tree which is the nearest to the coconut tree distribution map and has the 'Picked' mark 0 as the target coconut tree in the coconut tree distribution map based on the current navigation position, and outputting the coordinate position of the target coconut tree; receiving the current navigation position and the coordinate position of the target coconut tree, and determining a drive control signal which is used for departure to the coordinate position of the target coconut tree based on the distance between the current navigation position and the coordinate position of the target coconut tree.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses tree locations and harvest records to guide movement towards unpicked coconut trees.

title: Device for holding a sensor, in particular a camera, in a contactless position relative to harvested goods on a harvester
abstract: The device (1) has a sensor (3) brought into a position (p1) relative to a longitudinal middle plane (5) of a harvesting machine (4) for different working situations of the machine. The sensor is mounted relative to the machine by a parallelogram guide. The guide has a support element, which is guided parallel to a console for receiving the sensor. A hydraulic drive controls the positions of the sensor. The sensor is aligned by pivoting around a vertical pivot axle (6), which is pivotably mounted at the support element.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): It positions a sensor on a harvester, but the measurement and its use are unclear.
Second Reviewer: I think this may be a supplemental technology (holding a camera in an adaptive way). Should probably fall in PA or maybe meta PA :) It definitely helps a device that helps PA, but I don't know if that's enough for a (1) -- so my (1) is not so hot!

title: Edge-based processing of agricultural data
abstract: Implementations are disclosed for selectively operating edge-based sensors and/or computational resources under circumstances dictated by observation of targeted plant trait(s) to generate targeted agricultural inferences. In various implementations, triage data may be acquired at a first level of detail from a sensor of an edge computing node carried through an agricultural field. The triage data may be locally processed at the edge using machine learning model(s) to detect targeted plant trait(s) exhibited by plant(s) in the field. Based on the detected plant trait(s), a region of interest (ROI) may be established in the field. Targeted inference data may be acquired at a second, greater level of detail from the sensor while the sensor is carried through the ROI. The targeted inference data may be locally processed at the edge using one or more of the machine learning models to make a targeted inference about plants within the ROI.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): detects plant traits and collects detailed data from selected field areas.

title: PRECISION FARMING SYSTEM WITH SCALED SOIL CHARACTERISTICS
abstract: A method of selecting a treatment recommendation for nitrogen loss in a field includes measuring a first characteristic of a soil sample that is related to biologic nitrogen loss to produce a measured value. A second characteristic of the soil sample is measured and is used to select a sample group for the soil sample. The measured value is scaled based on the soil sample group the soil sample is placed into to form a scaled measure and the scaled measure is used to select a treatment recommendation.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses soil measurements to recommend treatments for nitrogen loss.

title: Tractor and baler combination with automatic baling and tractor halt control
abstract: A tractor comprises a tractor frame, driven ground engaging means, and an electronic tractor controller. A baler comprises a baler frame coupled or connected to the tractor frame, a crop receiving means, a baling chamber, a bale size sensor associated with the baling chamber, and an electronic baler controller. The baler controller is operable to submit a halt signal to the tractor controller when a bale size signal provided by the bale size sensor indicates that a bale has reached a size equal to or exceeding a first predetermined size. The tractor controller is operable to command the ground engaging means to automatically halt the tractor when receiving a halt signal from the baler controller. A steering controller is connected to a swath position sensor and operable to automatically steer the tractor along a swath based upon the signals of the crop swath sensor and of the bale shape sensor such that a uniform bale shape is obtained.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses crop and bale sensors to steer the tractor and control baling automatically.

title: INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE, INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: To easily and correctly perform calibration with respect to ambient light.SOLUTION: An information processing device includes a color temperature estimation section for estimating a color temperature of ambient light on the basis of detection values of illuminance of multiple wavelength bands of the ambient light detected by an illuminance sensor. The present technique can be applied to a system for calculating an evaluation index such as an NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) by performing remote-sensing of an agricultural land, for example.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5
Reasoning (First Reviewer): improves light calibration for agricultural remote sensing and vegetation measurements.

title: Ground-engaging implement with lateral position adjustment
abstract: A carrier adjustment assembly for coupling to a frame member of an implement includes a laterally adjustable carrier configured to be coupled to an opener and a first outlet providing at least one nutrient. The assembly further includes a plurality of lateral spacers positioned adjacent to the carrier to laterally adjust the carrier and provide a plurality of adjustment positions. The carrier adjustment assembly facilitates lateral adjustment of the carrier by removal of at least one captively held lateral spacer that sets the lateral adjustment of the carrier, a lateral adjustment of the first outlet, and an adjustment of a lateral separation between a seed row provided by a second outlet and a nutrient row provided by the first outlet.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): mechanically adjusts fertilizer placement without sensing or adaptive control.

title: Remote sensing technology based photovoltaic-cell spraying unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to a remote sensing technology based photovoltaic-cell spraying unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wing arms and wings. A signal receiving module arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle body is used for receiving remote signals, a pesticide box is fixed under the unmanned aerial vehicle body, spray nozzles and a camera are mounted at thebottom of the pesticide box, each spray nozzle is provided with an electromagnetic valve used for receiving the remote signals, vertical pesticide tubes are evenly distributed in the pesticide box, bottoms of the pesticide tubes are mutually connected to form a liquid pesticide collecting chamber, spraying mouths are arranged in the bottom of the liquid pesticide collecting chamber and are connected with the spray nozzles, a pressure pump used for receiving the remote signals is arranged in the pesticide box, and the unmanned aerial vehicle is further provided with a photovoltaic cell assembly. By the arrangement, shaking of the unmanned aerial vehicle due to inertia of liquid pesticide during the flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be guaranteed, so that balanced remote control is realized, and flight endurance can be improved through the photovoltaic cells.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): remotely controls drone spraying, but targeted or adaptive application is not described.
Second Reviewer: Application -> pest control, and mention of remote sensing. However, still not sure whether it's enough for PA. (we had another really similar UAV above, way above!)

title: INVERSE MODELING FOR CHARACTERISTIC PREDICTION FROM MULTI-SPECTRAL AND HYPER-SPECTRAL REMOTE SENSED DATASETS
abstract: Provided are methods and related devices for predicting the presence or level of one or more characteristics of a plant or plant population based on spectral, multi-spectral, or hyper-spectral data obtained by, e.g., remote sensing. The predictions and estimates furnished by the inventive methods and devices are useful in crop management, crop strategy, and optimization of agricultural production.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses spectral data to estimate plant characteristics for crop management.

title: GPS controlled guidance system for farm tractor/implement combination
abstract: Embodiments of the present invention comprise a system for positioning a drawn implement having a transverse tool bar being pulled by a vehicle traveling generally along a desired path of movement, the vehicle having a mounting hitch on the rear end thereof where a system hitch is configured to adjust its angular orientation and that of the tool bar relative to the vehicle mounting hitch and a global positioning system having an antenna mounted on the system hitch operable to detect the position of the tool bar of the implement relative to the desired path as the vehicle moves generally along the desired path and generate a signal that is indicative of the lateral position of the implement relative to the desired path and means for controlling the hitch means to adjust the angular orientation of the hitch means and the tool bar so that the implement follows the desired path of movement in response to the global positioning system signals.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses GPS to keep a tractor’s implement on the intended path.

title: Cultivated land ridge coefficient estimation method and device based on geographically weighted regression model
abstract: The invention relates to a cultivated land ridge coefficient estimation method and device based on a geographically weighted regression model and belongs to the technical field of cultivated land resource investigation. The method comprises steps of carrying out the calculation according to a quadrat distribution diagram based on an optical satellite image of a to-be-estimated region, and obtaining the ridge coefficient of each quadrat in the to-be-estimated region; based on the ridge coefficient of each sample and the slope data of each sample, constructing a ridge coefficient estimation model of each local cultivated land by adopting a geographically weighted regression method; performing spatial interpolation calculation according to the regression coefficient, the constant term and a regression residual error of each local cultivated land ridge coefficient estimation model to correspondingly obtain regression coefficient spatial distribution data, constant term spatial distributiondata and regression residual error spatial distribution data; and based on the distribution data and the gradient data of the to-be-estimated area, carrying out substitution calculation and cutting processing to obtain an estimated value of the farmland ridge coefficient. According to the method, the cultivated land ridge coefficient of the to-be-estimated area can be rapidly obtained, and spatial distribution heterogeneity of the ridge coefficient can be accurately represented.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): surveys cultivated land resources rather than supporting precision crop operations.
Second Reviewer: Agreed, I don't know enough about farming to comment on this..

title: WORK VEHICLE
abstract: To perform stably and safely automatic steering of a work vehicle (1) during a backward movement, the work vehicle (1) comprises: a vehicle body (3) that can travel forward and backward by either of manual steering through a steering handle (30) or automatic steering; a prime mover (4) provided on the vehicle body; a work device (2) supported by the vehicle body; a PTO shaft (16) for transmitting power of the prime mover to the work device; and a control device (60) for controlling drive of the PTO shaft and the automatic steering, wherein, when the PTO shaft is stopped, the control device permits the automatic steering in the vehicle body during a backward movement, and when the PTO shaft is driven, the control device prohibits the automatic steering in the vehicle body during a backward movement.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): controls automatic steering, but the agricultural application needs confirmation.
Second Reviewer: PTO shaft most likely related to a tractor. Not sure but maybe https://www.fieldbee.com/blog/5-advantages-of-automatic-steering-technology-in-farming

title: System for controlling engine operating speed based on operating load
abstract: A machine includes an engine and a governor operable to control an operating speed of the engine along a first droop curve such that the operating speed is a function of an operating load of the engine. The first droop curve includes a first region that defines a first slope, a second region that defines a second slope different from the first slope, and a transition point located at an intersection of the first region and the second region. The machine further includes a controller in communication with the governor. The controller is configured to determine an average operating load of the engine over a predetermined time period, adjust the location of the transition point based at least in part on the average operating load to create a second droop curve, and operate the engine based on the second droop curve.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): adjusts engine speed to load without describing a precision farming function.

title: Satellite remote sensing-based drought monitoring system and method for cotton drip irrigation under mulch
abstract: The invention discloses a satellite remote sensing-based drought monitoring system for cotton drip irrigation under mulch. The monitoring system comprises a soil analysis and division module, a meteorological monitoring module, a phenological period observation module, a cotton growth monitoring module and a drought monitoring and early warning module. In order to better realize the functions of the system, the invention also provides a satellite remote sensing-based drought monitoring method for cotton drip irrigation under mulch. The condition of soil difference in different areas of a cotton field is considered, a comprehensive growth index instead of a single growth index is used when a cotton growth model is generated, and the obtained cotton growth vigor model has higher stability.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): monitors cotton growth and drought while accounting for soil differences across the field.

title: Automated detection of errors in location data in agricultural operations
abstract: In an embodiment, a server computer receives, over a digital communication network, agricultural data records comprising a plurality of planting and harvesting data values. Each of the planting and harvesting data values include geo-location coordinates and corresponding timestamps. The server generates a plurality of planting datasets by aggregating planting data values based on geo-location coordinates and timestamps. The server generates a plurality of harvesting datasets by aggregating harvesting data values based on geo-location coordinates and timestamps. The server determines a dataset of planting-to-harvesting matching pairs based upon nearest proximities between geo-location coordinates of planting datasets and geo-location coordinates of harvesting datasets. The server determines geo-location error values representing offsets of between geo-locations of corresponding planting-to-harvesting matching pairs. The server presents the geo-location error values on a display screen of a client computer.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): detects location errors in planting and harvesting data.

title: Variable-rate fertilizing device capable of achieving variable-proportion mixed discharge
abstract: The invention provides a variable-rate fertilizing device capable of achieving variable-proportion mixed discharge. The variable-rate fertilizing device mainly comprises a fertilizer box 1, a fertilizer box 2, a fertilizer box 3, a frame, fertilizer-discharge grooved wheels, a static mixer, a motor, a drive belt wheel, driven belt wheels, a tensioning wheel 1 and a tensioning wheel 2, wherein the motor drives the drive belt wheel to rotate, power is transmitted to the driven belt wheels through belt transmission so as to drive the fertilizer-discharge grooved wheels to rotate to discharge fertilizer, the tensioning wheel 1 and the tensioning wheel 2 are respectively controlled to allow belt transmission tensioning force to change so as to change the equivalent diameter of the driven belt wheels, stepless speed regulation of the fertilizer-discharge grooved wheels can be achieved in a certain range, the fertilizer discharge amount can be changed, precise variable-proportion fertilizer discharge is achieved, each driven belt wheel adopts split design, and the left part and the right part of the driven belt wheel form crossed V-shaped grooves. The variable-rate fertilizing device has the advantages that different-proportion fertilizer mixing is achieved by using one power source to change transmission ratio, fast mixing is achieved through the static mixer, real-time fertilizer proportion change and fast variable-rate fertilizing are achieved, and the variable-rate fertilizing device is simple in structure and reliable in performance.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): enables real-time changes in fertilizer application rates and mixture proportions

title: Spraying control method and device, and electronic equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a spraying control method and device, and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of agriculture. The spraying control method comprises the step of controlling at least one spraying window to slide on a to-be-processed map based on an operation path; when the spraying window slides to each sliding position, determining a target grid regionappearing in the same spraying window at the same time; and when the spraying window slides to each sliding position, evaluating the spraying amount corresponding to the nozzle of the operation equipment according to the determined plant height mean value of the target grid area. According to the method, the difference of growth vigor of plants in different areas is considered during spraying control, high-pertinence and high-precision spraying operation can be achieved, and the crop yield is increased.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): adjusts spraying amounts according to plant height in different field areas.

title: Fiber-optic bundle for in-situ spectral sensor, spectral sensor and method of making and using the same
abstract: Fiber-optic bundles for infrared spectral analysis of media. The fiber-optic bundles can be used in infrared probes configured to be inserted in media for in-situ characterization of the media. The fiber-optic bundles can include a plurality of optical fibers arranged in a spatial pattern at a sampling end of the bundle to improve a signal of infrared spectral measurements. In-situ probes of the present disclosure can be used for precision farming practices to improve soil health and increase crop yields.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): supports in-situ soil measurements for precision farming.

title: Robotic tool with boundary wire loop
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a self-propelled robotic tool (1) comprising a work implement (3), a driving arrangement (5, 7, 9, 11) for moving the robotic work tool, a control device (13) for controlling the driving arrangement, and an acquisition device (23, 25), configured to record a signal (27; 31) transmitted in bursts by a boundary wire loop (19), wherein the control device is configured to determine whether the robotic work tool is located within an area (17) defined by the boundary wire loop based on the recorded signal. There is provided a digital signal processor (39) which is configured to provide an output corresponding to an average of a plurality of recorded transmitted signal bursts, wherein the control device (13) is configured to determine whether the robotic tool (1) is located within said area (17) at least partly based on said output.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): keeps a robot within a boundary, but no crop-production application is specified.
Second Reviewer: Agreed

title: Multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle for crop pest control operation
abstract: The invention provides a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle for crop pest control operation, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a fuselage and a spraying device, a liquid storage tank is inserted in the fuselage, an unpowered self-control inner core for controlling liquid stability and adjusting liquid uniformity is arranged in the liquid storage tank, and the unpowered self-control inner core comprises a central column; laminates are evenly arranged on the central column, a plurality of through grooves are formed in the laminates, rotating shafts are symmetrically connected into the through grooves, floating plates used for shielding the through grooves are rotationally connected to the symmetrical rotating shafts, a middle piece is rotationally connected between the floating plates, and a transverse floating plate is connected to the bottom of the middle piece. According to the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle for crop pest control operation, shaking in liquid can be restrained in the speed changing or steering process of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, and the flight stability of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is improved; meanwhile, the pesticide liquid can be continuously homogenized to a certain degree on the basis that the flight stability of the multi-rotor pesticide spraying unmanned aerial vehicle is not affected.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): stabilizes and mixes pesticide inside a drone tank without precision application control.

title: METHOD FOR INCREASING EFFICIENCY OF USING MOBILE UNIT EQUIPPED WITH DRONE
abstract: FIELD: agriculture.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to agriculture, in particular to a vehicle equipped with drones. Drones are installed on vehicle cabin roof. Drones are connected by means of eclectic cable or fuel line with accumulator or fuel tank of transport facility. Vehicle is coupled with a container (or several containers) containing liquid pesticides, herbicides, fertilizers, which are pumped by means of a pump of the reservoir to sprayers installed on drones. Drones are controlled at the initial stage by the operator by selecting the operation on the display. Then the unit software tests the operation of systems and devices of drones and forms the task for each involved drone.EFFECT: use of invention will make it possible to improve quality of treatment of agricultural lands of any shape within reach of cable-hoses connected with drones.1 cl, 5 dwg
Reasoning (First Reviewer): assigns spraying tasks to tethered drones, but the precision-control functions are unclear.
Second Reviewer: The mentioned effect fits the bill and the forming of the tasks is probably based on some sensing (or something to that effect)

title: Technical method of high survival rate mountain afforestation through afforestation robot
abstract: The invention discloses a technical method of high survival rate mountain afforestation through an afforestation robot, and belongs to the field of generalized 3S integration technology mountain aerial seeding afforestation. According to the method, a UAV photogrammetry technology, a GIS space division and analysis technology, a GNSS space navigation technology and an air high pressure ejection technology are integrated into a whole, a 3S technology is comprehensively utilized, and by means of the integrated whole process operation from data acquisition and spatial division analysis to preciseaerial seeding afforestation and forest management, the high-efficiency, high-precision, high survival rate mountain afforestation objective is achieved. According to the technical method, an existing mountain afforestation technology is improved and innovated, the extensive operation mode of traditional mountain afforestation is changed, the high-precision integrated operation mode is achieved,and the method is suitable for application and popularization.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): regards mountains

title: Procédé d’aide à la conduite d’un véhicule agricole tracteur ou enjambeur et véhicule pour sa mise en œuvre
abstract: Procédé d’aide à la conduite d’un véhicule agricole tracteur ou enjambeur et véhicule pour sa mise en œuvre L’objet de l’invention concerne un procédé d’aide à la conduite d’un véhicule agricole tracteur ou enjambeur (1), progressant sur un sol (S) en suivant des rangs de culture en ligne (R), le procédé comprenant les étapes suivantes :- projeter sur le sol deux bandes lumineuses (17) de forme rectangulaire, parallèles entre elles et aux rangs de culture en ligne, - observer les bandes lumineuses (17) projetées sur le sol en vue de détecter une déformation d’au moins l’une des bandes lumineuses correspondant à une dérive de la progression du véhicule,- et lorsqu’une déformation de la bande lumineuse est détectée, agir sur le système de direction du véhicule afin que la bande lumineuse retrouve sa forme rectangulaire. Figure pour l’abrégé : Fig. 2.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses projected light bands to help keep an agricultural vehicle aligned with crop rows.

title: CROP ROW GUIDANCE SYSTEMS
abstract: Described herein are technologies for guiding an agricultural vehicle (1..N) through crop rows using a camera (116, 118, 119) and signal processing to locate the crop row or centers of the crop row. The signal processing uses a filter to filter data from images captured by the camera and locates the row or the centers based on the filtered data. The filter is generated based on a signal processing transform and an initial image of the crop row captured by the camera. The filter is applied to subsequent images of the crop row captured by the camera. In some embodiments, the camera includes one lens. For example, monocular computer vision is used in some embodiments. Also, in some embodiments, a central processing (102) unit generates the filter based on the transform and the initial image of the crop row and applies the generated filter to the subsequent images of the row.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses camera images to locate crop rows and guide agricultural vehicles.

title: REAL-TIME VARIABLE RATE APPLICATION SYSTEM AND REAL-TIME VARIABLE RATE APPLICATION METHOD USING DRONES
abstract: Disclosed are a real-time variate application method using a drone and a real-time variate application system using a drone. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the real-time variate application method using a drone includes the following steps of applying fertilizer retained by a drone to an application area in farmland, which is designated based on a current spot of a drone, by a set application amount; photographing a next application area in the farmland through a camera mounted on the drone, while the fertilizer is being applied to the application area; controlling the flight of the drone along a set flight route when the application to the application area is completed; and setting the amount of fertilizer to be applied to the next application area by changing the amount by a predetermined value, considering the growth condition of crops confirmed from the photographed image, during the flight control.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): adjusts drone fertilizer application according to crop conditions detected in images.

title: Assistant decision making system for agricultural planting
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an assistant decision making system for agricultural planting. The assistant decision making system for agricultural planting comprises a data processing and decision making system and a display terminal. The data processing and decision making system combines environment data with geographic data of a region and conducts evaluation and calculation. The display terminal classifies and displays evaluation and calculation results of the data processing and decision making system. According to the auxiliary decision making system for agricultural planting, an adopted information platform can integrate a plurality of heterogeneity databases, such as a farming, climate and soil database, and the adopted information platform, the geographic information system and the general circulation model are integrated into a global climate variation decision support system; simulation and analysis are conducted by means of calculation of a cloud platform, and for the topics such as the greenhouse effect, water source management, farmland resource sustainable utilization, agricultural insurance essential data and agricultural disaster loss evaluation, decision-making is assisted.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): supports regional agricultural decisions, but its role in field-level crop management is unclear.
Second Reviewer: According to the definition.

title: Autonomous flight system for agricultural disease control and method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to an autonomous flight system for prevention of agricultural disasters and a method thereof, which enable a pest control flight by automatically setting an accurate pest control zone through a plurality of GPS modules and cameras provided in an unmanned aerial vehicle and then, planning a pest control route for the pest control zone. The autonomous flight system of the present invention can check the boundary of a pest control target by photographing a target flight zone with the cameras provided in the unmanned aerial vehicle while automatically ascending, automatically generate the pest control route for the pest control zone defined by the boundary, determine zones for different types of pest control based on vegetation status of the pest control zone obtained through a normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) camera, and automatically apply the determined zones to the pest control route. Therefore, it is possible to automatically perform pest control optimized for agricultural pest control while automatically generating a route without expert knowledge or a prior boundary setting process.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): uses GPS, cameras and vegetation data to plan targeted agricultural pest control.

title: Intelligent platform applied to agriculture
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent platform applied to agriculture, wherein a data acquisition module is used for collecting data of a remote sensing satellite and a sensor group which is arranged in a farmland, and simultaneously marking the collected data in a longitude and latitude manner and transmitting the collected longitude-latitude-marked data to a central server group; the central server group stores the received data in a database, and meanwhile, the database saves historical agricultural yield and current crop market average price of each region of the whole country; a weather collecting module is used for collecting weather information; a data analyzing module is used for invoking data in the database, outputting the yield and price curve chart of agricultural products according to the data saved in the database, predicting the current crop yield and price according to the yield and price curve chart, and simultaneously drawing a current planting map; an information pushing module is used for pushing the yield and price curve chart predicted by the data analyzing module and the planting map drawn by the data analyzing module into a client. The intelligent platform applied to the agriculture has the advantage of avoiding food wastes.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): collects georeferenced field sensor and satellite data to support crop monitoring and planning.

title: Agricultural spraying UAV achieving drainage with negative-pressure pressurization
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural spraying UAV achieving drainage with negative-pressure pressurization. The agricultural spraying UAV comprises a pesticide adding cover, a liquid level observation port, a fuselage, a spraying device, a landing frame and a heat dissipation hole. After the spraying device is started, a forward blade and a reverse blade provide flight power. A rotating mechanism is rotated by the wind during the rotation of the forward blade, thereby rotating a spraying port. A pressurizing mechanism operates in conjunction with rotation of a drive shaft, and drives a negative-pressure mechanism to pressurize the inside of the spraying port. The agricultural spraying UAV improves the penetrating power of the spraying, enables the pesticide to enter the vigorous plantsquickly and effectively, prevents workers from spraying for the second time, and saves the pesticide dosage.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): improves spray pressure and penetration without describing targeted or adaptive application.

title: APPLICATION REPORT AND METHOD FOR CREATING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention is a method of creating a product application report (10) automatically using data collected by a crop product applicator controller (54). The controller (54) collects data relating to the amount, type, and location of crop products applied. Other data, such as data relating to weather, the identity of the applicator operator, and vehicle parameters, may likewise be collected. When all the data is collected, the data is used to create a report (10) which meets state, federal, and local regulations. The report (10) can then be printed or electronically stored in a database.
Reasoning (First Reviewer): automatically records the amount, type and location of crop inputs applied in the field.
